newsitem.title: USA: Texaco to boost image through ads - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Texaco to boost image through ads - WSJ.

text.p: Texaco Inc has hired a black-owned advertizing agency called UniWorld Group to make commercials designed to improve its corporate image among minorities, the Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday.
The newspaper said the company's move was part of a plan to hire more firms owned by minorities after settling the widely-covered racial discrimination lawsuit.
It quoted a Texaco spokesman as saying the first advertizements will start appearing next week in publications and radio stations with minority audiences.
The cost of the campaign was not disclosed, it added.
UniWorld has done work for clients like AT&T Corp and Ford Motor Co's Loncoln/Mercury division.
